questions.question: Let R be a relation on the set of integers Z defined by aRb if a - b is divisible by 5. What type of relation is R?
options: Reflexive and symmetric but not transitive
questions.explanation: a - a = 0 is divisible by 5 (reflexive); if a - b is div by 5, then -(a-b) = b - a is div by 5 (symmetric); if a - b and b - c are div by 5, (a-b)+(b-c) = a - c is div by 5 (transitive). Hence R is an equivalence relation.

practice_questions.question: Let R be a relation on the set of integers Z defined by aRb if a - b is divisible by 5. What type of relation is R?
options: Reflexive and symmetric but not transitive
practice_questions.explanation: a - a = 0 is divisible by 5 (reflexive); if a - b is div by 5, then -(a-b) = b - a is div by 5 (symmetric); if a - b and b - c are div by 5, (a-b)+(b-c) = a - c is div by 5 (transitive). Hence R is an equivalence relation.
